# 2 Baruch Chapter 81 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**81:1** "Hear-therefore, O-Israel, and-be-instructed-by-me, O-Jacob; and-remove-not from-your-hearts the-way-of-life."

**81:2** "I-call-heaven-and-earth as-witnesses against-you this-day, that-you-have-chosen death-and-life."

**81:3** "And-if-you-choose-the-way-of-life, you-will-live; and-if-you-choose-the-way-of-death, you-will-die."

**81:4** "For-the-mercy-of-the-Mighty-One endures-forever, and-his-power, from-generation-to-generation; and-his-kingdom endures-for-ever-and-ever."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
